# District-wise Dengue: 2025

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Figure 1: District-wise Dengue Cases for the Year 2025"
#| out-width: 100%
#| out-height: 1000px
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(denguedatahub)
library(ceylon)
library(stringdist)  # for fuzzy matching
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(plotly)



# Aggregate annual data
data(srilanka_weekly_data)

annual_df <- srilanka_weekly_data %>%
  group_by(year, district) %>%
  summarise(
    annual_cases = sum(cases, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(year == 2025)

# Load Sri Lanka district polygons
data(district)

# Clean names
annual_df <- annual_df %>%
  mutate(district_clean = toupper(trimws(district)))

district_sf <- district %>%
  mutate(DISTRICT_clean = toupper(trimws(DISTRICT)))

# Fuzzy match
annual_df <- annual_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    DISTRICT_match = district_sf$DISTRICT_clean[
      amatch(district_clean, district_sf$DISTRICT_clean, maxDist = 3)
    ]
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Join
annual_sf <- district_sf %>%
  left_join(
    annual_df,
    by = c("DISTRICT_clean" = "DISTRICT_match")
  )

# IMPORTANT: Convert to longitude/latitude
annual_sf <- st_transform(annual_sf, 4326)

# Palette
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = annual_sf$annual_cases,
  na.color = "white"
)

# Map center for Sri Lanka
map1 <- leaflet(data = annual_sf) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(annual_cases),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", DISTRICT, "</b><br>",
      "Cases: ", annual_cases
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~annual_cases,
    title = "Dengue Cases (2025)"
  ) %>%
  setView(
    lng = 80.7, 
    lat = 7.8, 
    zoom = 7
  )
map1
```

# High Risk MOH Areas: 2025

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
DengueAtlas1 <- read_excel("dataraw/DengueAtlas.xlsx", sheet=1)
DengueAtlas2 <- read_excel("dataraw/DengueAtlas.xlsx", sheet=2)
df <- read_csv("dataraw/sri_lanka_areas_coordinates.csv")
df <- df |>
  rename(HighRiskMOHAreas = area)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
merged_df <- DengueAtlas1 |>
  dplyr::left_join(df, by = "HighRiskMOHAreas")

# View result
#head(merged_df)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-cap: "Figure 2: Aggregated dengue cases by MOH area in Sri Lanka for 2025. Hover over each circle to view the exact count for the MOH area."
#| out-width: 100%
#| out-height: 1000px
# Aggregate dengue counts by MOH area
merged_df$Cases <- as.integer(merged_df$Cases)
df_agg <- merged_df  |>
  group_by(HighRiskMOHAreas, longitude, latitude, District)|>
  summarise(TotalCases = sum(Cases), .groups = "drop")
df_agg <- df_agg |>
  mutate(Longitude = as.numeric(longitude),
         Latitude = as.numeric(latitude))


# Define color palette based on cases
# Define bins and color palette
bins <- c(1, 30, 60, 100, 150, 250, 500, 1000, 2000)  # your categories
pal <- colorBin(
  palette = viridis(7),  
  domain = df_agg$TotalCases,
  bins = bins,
  na.color = "grey"
)

# Leaflet map
map2 <- leaflet(df_agg) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    ~Longitude, ~Latitude,
   # radius = ~sqrt(TotalCases),  # size proportional to cases
    color = ~pal(TotalCases),
    stroke = TRUE,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    label = ~paste0(HighRiskMOHAreas, ": ", TotalCases, " cases")
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~TotalCases,
    title = "Dengue Cases",
    opacity = 1,
    labFormat = labelFormat(suffix = " cases")
  )
map2
```


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(leafsync)
library(htmltools)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 1. District-wise map
# --------------------------------------------------

district_sf <- annual_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(annual_cases))

district_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = district_sf$annual_cases
)

map1 <- leaflet(district_sf) %>%
 # addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~district_pal(annual_cases),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>District:</b> ", district,
      "<br><b>Annual cases:</b> ",
      format(annual_cases, big.mark = ",")
    ),
    group = "Districts"
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = district_pal,
    values = ~annual_cases,
    title = "Annual cases"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. MOH-area map
# --------------------------------------------------

moh_df <- merged_df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(longitude),
    !is.na(latitude),
    is.finite(longitude),
    is.finite(latitude),
    !is.na(Cases)
  )

moh_pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "RdPu",
  domain = moh_df$Cases
)

map2 <- leaflet(moh_df) %>%
  #addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    radius = ~pmax(4, sqrt(Cases) * 1.2),
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    fillColor = ~moh_pal(Cases),
    fillOpacity = 0.85,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>District:</b> ", District,
      "<br><b>MOH area:</b> ", HighRiskMOHAreas,
      "<br><b>Year:</b> ", Year,
      "<br><b>Week:</b> ", Week,
      "<br><b>Cases:</b> ", Cases
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = moh_pal,
    values = ~Cases,
    title = "MOH-area cases"
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# 3. Display side-by-side and synchronize
# --------------------------------------------------

leafsync::sync(
  map1,
  map2,
  ncol = 2
)



```
